description: Top-level index for Mastercam CAD-side authoring operations. Mastercam combines a CAD authoring layer with its CAM-side toolpath engine; this index covers ONLY the CAD authoring surface (wireframe / solid / surface / drafting / transformation / analysis / modify / file_layer). The CAM-side toolpath catalogs live separately under cam-functions/mastercam/ and are owned by the dedicated CAM exhaust roadmap. Coverage spans 8 modules following the Inventor parity pattern. Consumed by MastercamCADFunctionIndexEngine for parameter discovery and AI orchestration of Mastercam CAD authoring via NET-Hook in-host execution and Mastercam ChooseAndPick C-Hook surface.

modules.description: Wireframe entity creation: 8 line variants (Endpoints / Parallel / Perpendicular / Closest / Tangent), 5 circle variants (Center+Point / Center+Radius / 3-Points / 2-Points / Tangent), 3 arc variants (3-Point / Endpoints+Center / Tangent), Ellipse (full + partial), Polygon (regular 3..256 sides w/ optional fillet), Rectangle (4 placement modes), Shape (oval/slot/hexagon/diamond/D-shape/rounded_rect from built-in library), 2 spline variants (Parametric through-points + NURBS control-point), Curve Derive (from solid edges / surfaces / intersection / projection), Wireframe Text on path or straight, Helix (constant or conical), Spiral, and Point (8 creation modes including parametric / endpoint / intersection / perpendicular / on-entity). 24 operations total.

Solid modeling layer: 4 sweep features (Extrude / Revolve / Sweep / Loft) with 4 corresponding cut variants (Extrude_Cut / Revolve_Cut / Sweep_Cut / Loft_Cut), Boolean (add/subtract/intersect/common), 4 modify ops (Fillet — constant/variable/face_face with G1/G2/G3 continuity, Chamfer — distance/distance_distance/distance_angle/two_distances, Shell — multi-thickness override, Draft — neutral/parting modes), Thicken Surface (surface→solid bridge), Primitive (box/cylinder/cone/sphere/torus), Hole (5 types: simple/c-bore/c-sink/threaded/tapered) with 4 termination modes, and 2 patterns (Linear in 1 or 2 directions, Circular about axis). 18 operations total.
